title: parity-kernel: closed-form nulls and detection limits for intra-strand parity indices
description: Code, data and result tables for the paper "A Closed-Form Expectation for Intra-Strand Parity Indices and the Limits of Their Use as G-Quadruplex Descriptors" (NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics). Includes the closed-form expectation of an intra-strand parity index, the in silico mutagenesis of 538 putative quadruplex sequences, and the scripts behind every table and figure of the paper and its Supplementary Information.
